components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action per screen: Play, Write, Update, the suggested copy.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(0.72 0.15 68); color: oklch(0.16 0.02 65); font: 700 12px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.26); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 130ms linear, transform 130ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.72 0.15 68) 88%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.72 0.15 68); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-key { font: 600 11px/1 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; padding: 3px 5px 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.18); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Every other action; the danger variant turns red only when hovered, focused or armed.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 46px; padding: 0 17px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.16); border-radius: 5px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.04); color: oklch(0.97 0.006 75); font: 700 12px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 130ms linear, background-color 130ms linear; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.32); background: oklch(0.18 0.004 65 / 0.7); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.72 0.15 68); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: A save on the memory card: icon, name, and a lamp that says where it stands in shape and colour.

components.css: .ds-block { position: relative; width: 110px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 8px 10px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.075); background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.04); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-block[aria-selected=true] { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: oklch(0.72 0.15 68); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.72 0.15 68) 9%, oklch(0.185 0.006 65)); box-shadow: 0 12px 20px -12px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.85); } .ds-icon { width: 64px; height: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.72 0.15 68) 26%, oklch(0.185 0.006 65)); color: oklch(0.97 0.006 75); font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; } .ds-lamp { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.76 0.15 145); } .ds-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.97 0.006 75); text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: The launcher window is a console's cartridge slot and the cover art is the cartridge seated in it. Everything the system does comes from that one image: the cover fills the window, the chrome prints on top of it and gets out of its way, Eject rides the whole face out of the slot and leaves the empty slot behind, and a new cartridge comes out of its box the first time a machine sees it. It is read from a couch as often as from a desk, and driven by a gamepad as often as a mouse, so the system is quiet, warm and large where it matters.
keyCharacteristics: Cover art is the surface; chrome is a thin print over it.
One accent, sampled from the cartridge's own art, contrast-checked for its ink.
Warm near-black neutrals (hue 65–75), never cold grey.
Physical motion that means something: seat, eject, unbox. Nothing ambient.
Four actions on four face buttons; every control reachable by pad and keys.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The accent belongs to the cartridge. Never hard-code a brand hue where the accent goes; a greyscale cover resets to the stock amber rather than keeping the last game's.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: One filled button per screen. Everything else is ghost, text or icon.

rules.name: The Couch Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing that carries meaning is smaller than 11px, and anything read on the launcher from a distance is 12px or more, headlines 14px or more.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small label above a heading. A collection's name goes where its logo would, in the corner.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: No zero-offset coloured glow. Selection is a border in the accent and a lift, not light.

dos: Do let the cover be the surface; print chrome over it on a short scrim.
Do take the accent from the cartridge and check its ink for contrast.
Do say every state in words as well as colour, and before a risky action, not after.
Do give every action a key and a pad button, and show them.
donts: Don't put a small label above a heading.
Don't use a zero-offset coloured glow, a radial halo, or glass as decoration.
Don't set meaningful text below 11px, or below 12px on the launcher.
Don't give one pad button a destructive meaning on one screen and a different one on the next.
